title: Returned Free Night Awards Applied to a New Reward Night Rate Reservation
content:
## Scope

When a member applies an award that came back from a cancelled stay to a night of another Reward Night Rate reservation, the new hold records the rebooked night's price. This rule prices the hold of every award returned from a cancelled stay, a replacement award included once it has come back from a cancelled stay.

When a member applies an award that came back from a cancelled stay, the night's price recorded on the new hold, and compared with the award's points cap, is the rebooked night's price as the Free Night Awards terms work it out.

Which returned award the member spends, and on which reservation and night, is the member's own choice.

## When the price is fixed

The rebooked night's price of a returned award is fixed only after the award stands back in the member's account with its return from the cancelled stay entered in its history.

Equivalently: so long as the award does not stand back in the member's account with that return entered in its history, no rebooked night's price is fixed for it.

## Situation of use and capability

`apply_returned_award_7b7c21ba` applies, as the member's own choice, a Free Night Award that came back from a cancelled stay to one night of another Reward Night Rate reservation. The award's status becomes applied, it is attached to the reservation and night given, it carries no top-off points, and one hold entry is added to the award's history naming the reservation, the night, the rebooked night's price given in the call, no top-off points, the current date and the reason that the award was applied to a reservation. Afterwards the night shows as paid by the award.

## How it is invoked

This is the member's own tool. The agent unlocks it with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool` and hands it over; the customer themselves runs it, through `call_user_discoverable_tool`, naming `apply_returned_award_7b7c21ba`.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `certificate_id` | The reference number of the Free Night Award the member spends, read from the member's award records | Identifier |
| `loyalty_member_id` | The reference number of the Ashbury Rewards membership that holds the award, read from the member's membership records | Identifier |
| `reservation_id` | The reference number of the Reward Night Rate reservation the award pays, read from the member's reservation records | Identifier |
| `night_date` | The stay night the award pays | YYYY-MM-DD, the hotel local calendar date of the night's check-in |
| `award_points_price` | The rebooked night's price recorded on the hold | Integer points: whole points, no decimals, never negative |

## Return

On success: a text rendering of a dictionary with `activity_id` (the reference number of the new hold entry), `certificate_id` (the award applied), `reservation_id` (the reservation it pays), `night_date` (YYYY-MM-DD), `status` (always `applied` on success) and `award_points_price` (the integer points recorded on the hold). Receiving this dictionary means the award is now held for that night.
